title: Agent-ZTA: A chain-Aware Zero Trust Model for Bidirectional Security-State Propagation and Runtime Containment in Multi-Agent Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems increasingly delegate tasks and permissions across chains of autonomous agents that invoke protected tools. Although agent identities and delegated credentials may remain valid throughout a workflow, the security condition of any agent along the chain can deteriorate during runtime execution-either through upstream compromise or downstream ingestion of untrusted inputs. Authorization models based solely on the immediate caller and its static delegated scope fail to account for these mid-execution state changes. This paper develops Agent-ZTA, a chain-aware Zero Trust authorization and containment model that links runtime security-state changes across multi-agent delegation graphs. The model distinguishes an agent's path-specific delegated authority bound from the effective permissions currently exercisable under trusted policy. translated_title: Agent-ZTA：一种面向多智能体委托的链感知零信任模型，实现双向安全状态传播与运行时遏制
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统日益在由调用受保护工具的自主智能体组成的链之间委托任务与权限。尽管智能体身份和委托凭证在整个工作流中可能保持有效，但链上任何智能体的安全状态都可能在运行时执行过程中恶化——或因上游被攻破，或因下游摄入不可信输入。仅基于直接调用者及其静态委托范围的授权模型无法应对这些执行中途的状态变化。本文提出了Agent-ZTA，一种链感知的零信任授权与遏制模型，将多智能体委托图中的运行时安全状态变化相互关联。该模型区分了智能体的路径特定委托权限绑定与当前在可信策略下实际可行使的有效权限。它定义了一种具有独立执行的策略决策、认证……的架构。
tldr: 该论文提出Agent-ZTA，一种链感知的零信任授权与遏制模型，通过在多智能体委托图中双向传播运行时安全状态变化，识别上游被攻破或下游摄入不可信输入等执行期间的安全恶化，并实施运行时遏制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agent-ZTA, a chain-aware Zero Trust authorization and containment model that propagates runtime security-state changes bidirectionally across multi-agent delegation graphs and enforces runtime containment against mid-execution security deterioration such as upstream compromise or ingestion of untrusted inputs.
